summary: Mirion Technologies filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing that its board approved a new 2026 share repurchase program authorizing up to $250 million of Class A common stock, effective immediately and running through August 31, 2031 unless terminated or suspended. The company also reported repurchasing roughly 2.6 million shares for about $40 million in Q3 2026, substantially completing its prior $100 million program. Repurchases may occur via open market, privately negotiated, or block transactions under Rule 10b-18, subject to debt covenant constraints. Watch execution pace and leverage capacity.
